title: Set speed and volume for each text-to-speech card
summary: Speed and volume per text-to-speech card, cloned voices in any language, and one edit for a repeated phrase.

sections.title: Text to speech and voice cloning
sections.note: Tune each text-to-speech card on its own, and use cloned voices in any language.

items.body: Set speed and volume per card, or use **Apply to all cards**
Pick a speed when you download a session's audio
Cloned voices now speak any language
Open a cloned voice to listen to it and download its audio
Edit a repeated phrase once and every matching copy updates
See the back translation under the translated text
Proofreading rates are now set per language pair
Proofreading activity counts words instead of characters
